source_units: is a free level-dependent EQ plug-in that applies different EQ curves to quiet, mid-level, and loud parts of a signal. Version 2.4.0 includes minor bug fixes while keeping the Tone Shaper and Dynamic EQ workflows available in the same plug-in.
AAX / AU / VST3 for macOS 11 or later

until its refreshed build is published, and I have received reports that it works well. Windows AAX support is planned for a future release. Version 2.4.0 includes minor bug fixes. Version 2.0.0 fixed an AU startup issue reported in Logic Pro where inserting the plug-in immediately after launch and moving EQ bands could produce severe distortion, runaway output, and audio dropout until the plug-in was re-instanced.
Each range has its own EQ curve, so you can shape whispers / normal / peaks differently.
Screenshot: level bands and per-band EQ curve editing.

Keep quiet phrases warm, keep normal phrases clear, and tame harsh peaks — without crushing everything into one curve.
Different tonal balance for low-level room tone vs spoken words vs loud consonants — useful for consistent intelligibility.
Shape sustain and transients differently (e.g., brighten attacks while keeping body smooth).

source_summary: Free level-dependent EQ plug-in with separate curves for quiet, mid-level, and loud parts, plus Tone Shaper and Dynamic EQ workflows.
